item.title: New frog species found hidden in Amazon
item.description: Scientists identified a new frog species in the flooded forests of the western Amazon, distinguishing it from similar relatives through DNA analysis.

item.title: Brain structure may have been misdrawn in textbooks for 100 years
item.description: Scientists found that brain-cell axons may not be smooth tubes as textbooks have shown for over a century, but instead naturally resemble strings.
